verdict.rationale: AutoGen's own GitHub README shows an assistant agent that uses the Playwright MCP server. That is first-party evidence that agents built with AutoGen can consume tools from MCP servers. The evidence is a single example line, and the agent tutorial confirms only general tool use. Missing for 10: detailed MCP integration docs (transport types, configuring arbitrary servers, tool discovery), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Create a web browsing assistant agent that uses the Playwright MCP server.
AssistantAgent is a built-in agent that uses a language model and has the ability to use tools.
